responsibilities_block: Install and lay fiber-optic and electrical communications cables.
Splice fiber and locate line breaks.

page.work_context_block: In the morning, receive a repair order and collect supplies, then use an OTDR on site to locate the break. At midday, climb to replace cable, splice fiber, and test continuity with the network operations center. In the afternoon, enter an underground space to inspect and protect aging lines. In the evening, close the order and update records. If another outage occurs at midnight, deploy again to restore service.
